## repo branch ls

```text
Usage: libfossil repo branch ls [flags]

List branches

Flags:
  -h, --help           Show context-sensitive help.
  -R, --repo=STRING    Path to repository file

      --closed         Show only closed branches
```

## repo branch new

```text
Usage: libfossil repo branch new <name> [flags]

Create new branch

Arguments:
  <name>    Branch name

Flags:
  -h, --help              Show context-sensitive help.
  -R, --repo=STRING       Path to repository file
  -v, --verbose           Verbose output

      --from=STRING       Parent version (default: tip)
  -m, --message=STRING    Checkin comment
      --user=STRING       Checkin user (default: OS username)
      --nosign            Do not sign the branch's check-in, even with the
                          clearsign setting on
```
